purpose: Resolve the blocked 30-material Reference calibration domain without candidate information by applying the pre-existing five-level P2E08 temporal feasibility ladder to all 180 extension physical cases.
scientific_reason: PUB-P2E11 found 176/180 valid Reference pairs at coarse dt 0.0064 day; four failures at B02/B05, Se=0.98 prevent threshold construction. RossFast extension cases have not been executed.

matrix.comparison_at_each_level: one Reference coarse solve versus two sequential Reference half-step solves to same final physical time

selection_rule.selected_level: first level at which all 180 Reference pairs satisfy the unchanged hard Reference validity gates
selection_rule.after_selection: Only selected-level Reference metrics may feed the next independent Se-stratified threshold freeze.

threshold_rule_reserved_for_next_workuni.statistic: empirical maximum per metric over all 60 valid cases in exact Se stratum
threshold_rule_reserved_for_next_workuni.note: P2E11R identifies the common Reference level and emits the dataset. It does not execute RossFast.

negative_result_policy: If no listed temporal level is valid for all 180 cases, retain all failures and keep the extension experiment blocked. Do not drop B02/B05 or create route-specific calibration schedules.
